name: Integrated Farming in Micro Watershed Scheme
benefit: Type of Assistance and Entitlement: Training, Awareness program, Extension, Technology support, and Subsidy on inputs.
eligibility_rules: The applicant should be a permanent resident of Meghalaya. The applicant should be a bonafide farmer engaged in agriculture. The applicant should possess their own land or leased land of at least 0.025 hectares or more.
documents_required: Documents proof of possessing own or leased land
how_to_apply: Mode: Offline Application Process:Step 01: The eligible bonafide farmer can apply/write an application on plain paper.Step 02: Along with the application, attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).Step 03: Submit the duly filled and signed application along with the documents at the nearest office of the Agriculture Development Officer of a CD Block/Agriculture Circle. Mode of Selection of Beneficiary(s):The bonafide farmers shall be selected on a first come first serve basis. Whom to Contact: Agriculture Development Officer of respective CD Block/Agriculture circleSub-Divisional Agricultural Officer of the concerned sub-divisionsDistrict Agricultural Officer of the concerned districts
